title: catha senegalensis
intro: Catha senegalensis, commonly known as Khat, is a flowering plant native to the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. It is valued for its stimulant properties, which are attributed to its health benefits in reducing fatigue, improving mental alertness, and increasing appetite. The therapeutic actions of Catha senegalensis include its ability to act as a CNS stimulant, increasing the levels of dopamine, norepinephrine, and serotonin in the brain, thereby producing a sense of euphoria and energy. The bioactive constituents of Catha senegalensis include alkaloids, particularly cathinone, which is responsible for its psychoactive effects.
